Dialogue.Page: I knew it. I had a hunch that there was more to it before, but now this confirms it. This really is big.

For anyone who comes after me, each of these burned codes has an equivalent hidden within the "dreams". Unfortunately those appear to be burned as well, and so initially I thought they were completely useless.
However, once I figured out how to "talk" to them, I realized that they were secretly the solution to all of this. All I need to do is input the right things in the right order...

Interestingly, there are three uniquely-named signals coming from the top of the tower that correspond to each of the "dreams". I'm not sure how they tie-in yet, though the fact that there's only three of them makes me think they're related to the burned codes somehow.

Something to keep in mind: The signal leading to the Submerged Structure is actually the signal for this tower, rather than the other way around. That bit's confusing. Otherwise, each signal directly corresponds with each "dream".

Also, I'd imagine that if you've gotten this far, and haven't heard a word from me, I didn't make it back home. Guess it is what it is, being a traveler and all. You take risks, and make peace with the consequences.
